D: A kind young woman, kept as a servant by her stepfamily, gets to the royal ball with help from her Fairy Godmother.
P: Serve the mains when the pumpkin turns into a coach.
S: Golden corn fritters with spring onion and paprika
Corn kernels mixed with flour, egg, spring onion and a little paprika, fried in spoonfuls until golden, served with a sour cream and chive dip.
Cinderella carrying breakfast trays up the stairs

Little buttered toasts topped with soft, creamy scrambled egg, chives and a sliver of ham, laid out on silver trays. Cut 12 rounds from 6 slices of bread with a cutter, brush with 20g melted butter and toast at 180C for 8 minutes. Whisk 6 eggs with 50ml cream and salt. Melt 20g butter in a non-stick pan over low heat and stir the eggs slowly for 4 minutes until just set and creamy. Top each toast with a small piece of ham from 100g, a spoon of egg and chopped chives.
Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and prosciutto wrapped around melon, served on silver trays.
M: Creamy arborio risotto with roast pumpkin
Butternut pumpkin roasted at 200C, half mashed through a parmesan risotto stirred slowly with stock for 20 minutes, the rest folded in, finished with sage butter.

Golden roast chicken rubbed with butter, lemon and thyme, carved with crisp roast potatoes, honey carrots and a silky pan gravy. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g butter, the zest of 1 lemon, thyme and salt, put the lemon inside and roast at 200C for 75 minutes. Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes and roast in oil for 50 minutes. Roast 500g carrots with 1 tbsp honey for 35 minutes. Rest the chicken, then stir 1 tbsp plain flour into the pan juices with 300ml chicken stock and simmer until smooth.
W: Crisp baked meringue piped into little slippers
Meringue piped into little slipper shapes, baked at 100C for an hour, dusted with edible glitter and served with whipped cream and berries.
K: Blueberry juice, lemonade and lime over ice with frozen blueberries

Blueberry juice and lemonade with a squeeze of lime, poured over ice with frozen blueberries floating in it. Fill a jug with ice and a handful of frozen blueberries. Pour in 1L blueberry juice and 1L cold lemonade, then squeeze in the juice of a lime. Stir gently and pour into glasses before the clock strikes midnight.

s.note: Golden corn fritters with spring onion and paprika
s.how: Mix a drained can of corn kernels with 100g flour, 2 eggs, sliced spring onions and a pinch of paprika. Fry spoonfuls in a little oil until golden on both sides. Stir chopped chives through sour cream for the dip and serve the fritters warm.

s.note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto
s.how: Top 16 blinis with a little creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and a sprig of dill. Cut a rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each in a slice of prosciutto. Arrange both on silver trays and serve chilled to the guests.

m.note: Creamy arborio risotto with roast pumpkin
m.how: Roast 1kg diced butternut pumpkin at 200C until soft. Stir 300g arborio rice in butter, then add 1.25L hot stock a ladle at a time for 20 minutes. Mash half the pumpkin through, fold in the rest with grated parmesan and spoon over butter fried with sage leaves.

w.note: Crisp baked meringue piped into little slippers
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pipe into little slipper shapes on lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour. Cool, dust with edible glitter and serve with whipped cream and sliced strawberries.

d.note: Blueberry juice, lemonade and lime over ice with frozen blueberries
d.how: Fill a jug with ice and a handful of frozen blueberries. Pour in 1L blueberry juice and 1L cold lemonade, then squeeze in the juice of a lime. Stir gently and pour into glasses before the clock strikes midnight.
